messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE fired for pool=prod-gpu-us-west (incident PD-89421) — urgency: high
pd-bot: Incident PD-89421 created; routed to Eng Oncall rota. Escalation policy: gpu-pressure -> oncall -> oncall-lead
Alex R.: acked PD-89421 :hand:
Priya K.: oncall here, pulling logs now. any customer-visible alerts?
Sasha L.: seeing latency spikes on web-prod -> routing shows requests getting queued to fallback, but 20% are failing with 5xx from model-worker
Jamal T.: checking kube metrics. gpu-12-az1 and gpu-15-az2 showing sustained GPU mem at ~98% and repeated cuda alloc failures in logs
Alex R.: paste any tail of the worker logs?
Priya K.: tail from gpu-12-az1: ```
2026-02-12T12:11:02Z model-worker[pid=23456]: cuda runtime error (2): out of memory at /src/nn/alloc.c:128
2026-02-12T12:11:02Z model-worker[pid=23456]: failed to allocate 184467440... bytes, attempting cleanup
2026-02-12T12:11:05Z kvcache: cannot evict entry id=cbf3... size=12GB pinned=true
```
Sasha L.: looks like large pinned kv entries; we hit fragmentation so evictions aren't freeing contiguous memory
Jamal T.: nvidia-smi snapshot from gpu-12-az1: ```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.60.13  Driver Version: 525.60.13  CUDA Version: 12.0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Memory-Usage |
|  0   A100-SXM4     39436MiB / 40960MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes: PID  Type  GPU Memory |
|   23456 C  python3  38264MiB |
|   23457 C  python3  1200MiB  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
Alex R.: thanks. Priya, can you trigger kvcache-manager eviction with force/unsafe on that node? We need to free up the KV slots quickly.
Priya K.: running: `kubectl exec -n infra kvcache-manager -- evict --pool=prod-gpu-us-west --node=gpu-12-az1 --force`
infra-bot: kvcache-manager: eviction job started on gpu-12-az1 (job id evict-20260212-001)
Priya K.: infra-bot reports 4 entries evicted, freed ~18GB, fragmentation still ~0.65
Jamal T.: good, mem dropped to 82% on gpu-12-az1 but gpu-15-az2 jumped to 97% (maybe traffic shifted)
Alex R.: enable auto-burst to cpu fallback for the pool for next 15m: route=cpu-fallback, max-burst=150
Sasha L.: applying route change in infra config now. should shed the largest requests to cpu-worker.
Priya K.: applied. Confirming on router: `route change accepted id=rc-778`
pd-bot: PD-89421 acknowledged by Alex R.; escalation to oncall-lead scheduled in 10m if unresolved
Jamal T.: running a rolling restart of model-worker on gpu-15-az2 to reclaim fragmented allocations: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker --selector=node=gpu-15-az2`
Alex R.: heads-up: customers on plan=enterprise will see increased token latencies, notify CS?
Sasha L.: pinging @cs-ops and adding quick note to status page draft.
Priya K.: after restart, gpu-15-az2 mem down to 40%, overall pool mem ~60%, error rate back to baseline
Jamal T.: verified model-worker logs show no more cuda alloc failures in last 3 minutes
Alex R.: nice work. tagging follow-up: create INC-89421 postmortem + kvcache fragmentation mitigation ticket. Priya can you take on the post-incident action with details?
Priya K.: will create follow-up tickets and include diagnostic dump + commands used.
Sasha L.: adding temporary guardrail: reject any inference with context>200k tokens for prod-gpu pool until kv compaction landed.
Alex R.: handoff: my shift ends at 13:00 UTC, @Jamal T. you'll be oncall to monitor and drive the postmortem. please ack handoff here.
Jamal T.: acked handoff, taking over. I'll keep PD updated and escalate if we regress.
pd-bot: PD-89421 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. responders: Alex R., Priya K., Jamal T., Sasha L.
Alex R.: closing active chat for now — will update incident ticket with timeline and link to playbook run. Postmortem link (placeholder): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-89421
Sasha L.: :thumbsup: will follow up on automated compaction/eviction heuristics to avoid pinned-entry fragmentation
Priya K.: note: command history and kvcache debug logs uploaded to S3 s3://redwood-debug/PD-89421/ , perms=eng-oncall
Jamal T.: leaving a short runbook note in the incident: priority patch is to add soft-evict for pinned entries and a global compaction cron.
Alex R.: thanks team. moving to post-incident actions.
